objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: The neck is exceptionally long relative to the body, significantly exceeding the length of the torso.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: The head features paired, skin-covered bony protuberances (ossicones) rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Proportions: The forelegs are visibly longer than the hind legs, creating a sloping back profile from shoulders to hips.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: The body is covered in irregular, polygonal patches separated by lighter lines, distinct from stripes or solid colors.

objects.taxonomy_description: Equine mammal measuring 140-170 cm at withers with athletic build. Coat uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coloration with no black points. Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen). Head elongated with large expressive eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched and muscular. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs long and slender with single hoof per foot. Tail long with flowing hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Color variant of horse distinguished by reddish-brown coat.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stocky tailless marsupial measuring 60-85 cm in body length with robust rounded body form. Fur is dense, woolly, and grey-brown with distinctive white patches on chest, ears, and rump. Ears are large, rounded, and prominently furry with white marginal tufts. Nose is broad, leathery, and black with distinctive textured surface. Limbs are powerful with five digits each; forefeet feature two opposable thumbs for gripping eucalyptus branches. Claws are sharp and curved for climbing. Body exhibits stocky proportions with broad chest and rounded abdomen. Head is broad with small eyes and inconspicuous ears relative to body size. Weight ranges 4-15 kg with sexual dimorphism. Posture is typically upright when seated on branches.
